WITH DISTINCT p, t, DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) AS birth

MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team {team_name: 'Cedevita Olimpija'}), (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date LIKE '%/%' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) AS INT64) END AS birth_day,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date LIKE '%/%' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) ELSE CASE split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 2) WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12 END END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date LIKE '%/%' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 3) AS INT64) END AS birth_year
RETURN 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, p.name AS name_player
